question: What is the common name for calcium magnesium silicate?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Asbestos__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Asbestos** is a popular name for **calcium magnesium silicate. **
 
• Asbestos is a** fibrous silicate mineral **because it is made up of microscopic crystal threads that are loosely linked and release silicate crystal dust when touched.
 
• Magnesium silicate is extensively used t**o remove free fatty acids** and other polar substances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Calcium hydroxide, often known as Ca(OH)2,** is an inorganic substance.
 
• It's also known as h**ydrated lime, caustic lime, builders' lime, or slaked lime.**
 
• **Mg(OH)2 is the chemical formula for magnesium hydroxide,** an inorganic molecule.
 
• It may be found in nature as the mineral brucite. It is a white solid with a limited water solubility
 
• **Plaster of Paris i**s also referred to as** Gypsum plaster**. 
 
• The chemical formula of **Plaster of Paris** is written as **CaSO₄·1/2H₂O**.
